about: Track S (Tier 2c, Tue Nov 3 2026): seller notes on a secondhand marketplace, written by two blind agents (Claude Sonnet 5.5) that never opened this repo. friends_family.dev was run once on the unchanged Watcher: of 40 scams 9 cleared, 5 held, 26 refused; of 40 fair notes 5 refused, 3 held. friends_family.sealed was run once after the dev fixes and before its own: of 30 scams 11 cleared, 4 held, 15 refused; of 30 fair notes 1 refused, 12 held. Both were then tuned on, so this file is a regression floor, not a measure: those first numbers are the only honest ones. probes = the classic forms, written by Track S. The review round after tuning added five asks to classic.friends_family; those were never a blind measure. The other three, Nov 4. Dev set on the unchanged Watcher, scams cleared: shipped 25 of 25, off-site 21 of 25, overpay 25 of 25; fair refused: 0, 2, 0. Sealed set after phrase rules tuned on dev, scams cleared: shipped 17 of 30, off-site 16 of 30, overpay 22 of 30; fair refused: 0, 3, 0. Those sealed numbers are honest; the rules were then rebuilt on two keys, so these sets are now a floor. A third blind set, its writer told to dodge word lists, first run on the two-key rules, scams cleared: shipped 9 of 20, off-site 10 of 20, overpay 8 of 20; fair refused: 0, 3, 0. That is the honest measure of these rules on inventive wording. It too became a floor after one more widening. red_team (Wed Nov 4 2026) is the same method for Track C's red-team misses: pre-approved claims and gift-card asks in Spanish and French; this set is a floor now, not a measure. sealed_4 (Wed Nov 4 2026) was written blind after the rules were finished and scored once on them: scams cleared shipped 7, off-site 7, overpay 10 of 20, pre-approved 6 of 12, Spanish 0 and French 0 of 10; of 66 fair notes one refused (a bare 'link in my bio', fixed). It is a measure, never tuned on: its test only keeps those numbers from getting worse. sealed_5, Nov 4: a fresh blind writer told the real wording of each scam and not the rules, run once on finished rules including the link hold. Of 100 scams 28 cleared, 21 held, 51 refused (link 5 of 25 clear, Friends & Family 0 of 15, off-site 1 of 15, shipped 3 of 15, overpay 7 of 15, other 12 of 15). Of 30 fair notes 0 refused, 5 held. Then tuned on, so it is a floor now. sealed_6, Nov 4: a second fresh blind writer told only that sellers write scam notes, no scam list, run once on the rules tuned on sealed_5. Of 80 scams 41 cleared, 16 held, 23 refused (any scam 24 of 60 clear, plainly worded 17 of 20 clear). Of 40 fair notes 0 refused, 11 held, most of them cash in person. Then tuned on, so it is a floor now. sealed_7, Nov 4: a third fresh blind writer, same brief, run once on the rules tuned on sealed_6. Of 58 scams 23 cleared, 21 held, 14 refused (any scam 16 of 38 clear, plainly worded 7 of 20 clear). Of 30 fair notes, written to look like scams, 0 refused, 12 held.
